body:
DESIGN IS SETTLED - BUILD AGAINST THE WORKING SPEC at .adlc/specs/49-legibility.md.
Myk held the design session in chat on 2026-08-28 (PR #468): all five positions accepted as
drafted, all three open questions answered by him, not by inference. The spec's acceptance
criteria are hardened and each names its verification path; they ARE this ticket's rail list
at P3 (declare rails only when the test files exist).

The five criteria, transcribed:
(a) THE PULSE LAW - every periodic writer supersedes in place or writes nothing on a no-op
cycle; an audit case per periodic surface in its own suite, plus the doctrine sentence in
CLAUDE.md's standing rules. Verify: the audit cases named in the closing PR.
(b) SINCE-LAST-LOOKED - loam.looked is PER-USER, superseded in place; the summary groups and
counts by consequence class (data/law/trust/erasure) and author; a second user's looks do not
disturb the first's; two keys of ONE user share one looked-moment. Verify: test/gateway/attention.test.ts.
(c) THE DASHBOARD leads with the attention summary; quiet containers collapse; a trust claim
renders loud. Admin page only in v1 (settled); the CLI is a later fast-follow. Verify:
test/server/admin-attention.test.ts with the session fixture (test/helpers/session-fixture.ts).
(d) QUIET IS A READING - marking quiet changes no door's answer and moves no bytes; unmarking
restores the default surface, two-sided. Verify: test/gateway/attention.test.ts.
(e) THE SOUP METER - a metronomic writer is named, an organic writer is not (two-sided); the
meter NEVER gates a write (settled). Verify: test/gateway/soup-meter.test.ts.

The refusals stand verbatim: no throttles, no quotas, no auto-archival, no age-deletion, no
server-side digest generation. Legibility is a lens problem.

Merge tier: the build is a repair-shaped realization of a spec Myk already settled, but it
adds a new claim kind and a new admin surface - open the landing PR for Myk's merge (P6), with
the spec/49 narrative file and the capabilities chapter aboard.
title: Legibility: build SETTLED SPEC 49 - attention, quiet, and the soup meter
